name: Cheltenham Center for the Arts Summer Art Camp
description_short: Art day camp for ages 5 to 12 at Cheltenham Center for the Arts, mostly in two week themed sessions plus one week Crafty Kids weeks. Campers grouped by age rotate through painting, drawing, printmaking, clay, sculpture and theatre classes with professional art teachers, perform on the last day, and swim at a township pool on Wednesday afternoons.
refund_policy_summary: No refunds or proration for days missed because of a change in plans, vacation or illness.

sessions.name: Crafty Kids Week 1 (4 days, no camp June 19)

notes: Prices are the non-member full day rates (8:30 to 3:30). Member full day: $265, $560, $625, $330. Morning only: $150, $310, $345 or $185 ($140, $295, $330, $175 for members). 5% early bird discount if paid in full by May 1. Campers bring lunch. Pool trips for sessions 1 to 4 were marked TBD pending township updates. Teens 13 to 17 have separate Summer Teen Studios.
